fusions.name: Jumping Fold
fusions.desc: Flicks a folded jumper that springs into the first enemy it meets and deals 7 damage. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Pulp Spit
fusions.desc: Spits wet pulp in a narrow cone 4 tiles ahead that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung Crease
fusions.desc: Springs you 5 tiles forward off a folded crease. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Lily-Pad Leaves

riders.text: you skip across it faster than over ground
and you are off the leaf before the blow lands
and the damp feeds the ink

fusions.desc: Your pages hold you up: you walk on water and swamp as on solid ground.
